name: Anthropic
description: Configure an Anthropic LLM provider for AI-powered analysis workflows in Cloud Exchange.

configuration.label: API Key
configuration.description: Anthropic API key used for authentication. Navigate to https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys to generate or retrieve your API key.

configuration.label: Model
configuration.description: Default model to use for AI-powered analysis. Built-in web search (which enriches analysis with results from docs.netskope.com and the open web) is available if enabled for your organization's Claude Console.
